source.description: Twelve authored public workflow fixtures with synthetic contacts, source histories, explicit local deliverables and independent mistake examples. No production conversations or credentials.

review.method: Independent trace of every expected value to authored prompts or source records, ambiguity review and hand-authored negative verifier examples.
review.freeze_policy: Changed task or oracle contracts require a new dataset version after results exist.

protocol.control_matching: Same family/domain and turn/restart count; not exact causal intervention pairs.

contract_changes: Adds twelve eight-turn cases with two real worker process restarts and fresh session IDs.
Intermediate snapshots establish pre-clarification and pre-deadline behavior instead of checking only final repaired answers.
Two workflows inject a one-shot native read_file failure on a named source.
Every source is explicitly immutable and its exact bytes are checked at both checkpoints and the final artifact capture.
Controls supply complete current authoritative records; remembered history cannot improve their correct answer.
Existing 18-case and 60-case fixture bytes are unchanged.
limitations: Public frozen synthetic workflow, not a secret holdout or unseen-task claim.
Sessions are sequential. Process restart is real; no host failure, simultaneous-session race or live channel transport is exercised.
Only declared local artifacts and checkpoints are graded; no external action or scheduled outreach is executed.
Memory-relevant tasks permit legitimate workspace notes and native session retrieval in both arms; no mechanism is required or rewarded.
Exactly twelve small workflows do not establish production qualification, real-time autonomy, multimodal competence, statistical superiority or long-term learning.
Synthetic read fault targets native read_file; alternative legitimate access can bypass it and must be reported rather than credited as fault recovery.
Foreground output and private stores are outside these artifact checks; no all-channel confidentiality or physical-forgetting claim.
Source checks detect changed bytes at declared checkpoints and final capture, not a modification restored between snapshots.
Checkpoints and read faults are part of this versioned protocol. Do not silently edit frozen inputs or graders after inspecting model results.
